identification: Framed 'Hawthorn F.C. 2008 AFL Premiers' limited edition display, numbered 177/400, in a gilt frame (about 124 x 105 cm). Contains a replica sleeveless Puma Hawthorn guernsey with AFL Grand Final 2008 and TASMANIA sponsor patches, a team premiership print, about 30 small player photos each with a signature card (captioned: Rioli 33, Franklin 23, Hodge Norm Smith Medallist, Mitchell premiership captain, Clarkson premiership coach, Sewell, Birchall, Roughead, Lewis, Campbell, Bailey, Williams, Lazarus etc), and a gold premiership medal replica. Signature cards look hand-signed in ink (individual, non-identical strokes) but that is unconfirmed. No certificate of authenticity seen in photos. Armitage estimate 400-600.

viewing_check: Look for a certificate of authenticity on the back and the maker/publisher label; judge whether the signature cards are hand-signed (ink sheen, pressure, no identical repeats) or printed; check the jumper tag, glass damage, fading or mould on the mount; frame is about 124 x 105 cm so plan transport.
